name: en-mirror
description: English mirror of the Thai team: 41 memories and 12 questions that must return nothing, half vague ("summarize the project") and half off-topic.

memories.content: Never use npm in this project, use pnpm only
Use Redis as the cache for user sessions with a TTL of 30 minutes
The notification system uses Redis as a temporary queue
Cache the product list API results in Redis for 5 minutes
The main database is PostgreSQL 16 running on db-prod-01
Back up the database data every day at 2am with pg_dump and upload to S3
Back up user uploaded files to a separate S3 bucket every week
Before deploying to production the team lead must approve in GitHub Actions
No deploys on Friday after 3pm
The staging server restarts automatically every night at midnight
The API server has 16GB RAM; if usage exceeds 80% notify the DevOps team
The dev server is shut down on weekends to save cost
The login page bug is caused by an expired token that is not refreshed; call AuthService.refreshToken() first
Authentication uses JWT valid for 15 minutes and refresh tokens valid for 7 days
Every PR needs at least 2 reviewers before merging into main
Name branches feature/task-name or fix/ticket-number
Commit messages are written in English but code comments may be in Thai
Times in the database are stored as UTC but shown on the website in Thailand time (Asia/Bangkok)
The payment system integrates with Omise and uses a webhook to confirm transfers
Support PromptPay payments with a QR code generated from the company account number
Unit test coverage must not drop below 80% or CI fails
Never commit the .env file to git; keep secrets in Vault
Run docker compose up -d before running integration tests every time
Team meeting every Monday at 10am on Google Meet
Daily standup at 9:30, no longer than 15 minutes
Every API route must start with /api/v2; v1 will be shut down at the end of this year
The public API is limited to 100 requests per minute per IP
Logs must be JSON and must not contain personal data such as national ID or phone numbers
Customer data must be stored on servers located in Thailand per PDPA
Thai web font is Sarabun and headings use Prompt
Sorting Thai names needs the th-TH collation or leading vowels sort wrong
Thai search in Elasticsearch needs the ICU tokenizer for word segmentation
Dates in reports are shown in the Buddhist era but the API always sends the Gregorian year
The mobile app is written in Flutter and supports Android 8+ and iOS 14+
New employees must request VPN access from the IT team before their first day
The project structure is split into apps/ and packages/ as a Turborepo monorepo
This project uses Node.js 20 LTS only
calculateVat() applies 7% VAT; never change the VAT_RATE constant yourself
ERR_ORDER_409 means a duplicate order; return the existing order instead of creating a new one
Send OTP by SMS through ThaiBulkSMS; it expires in 5 minutes
The backend team owns the payment system; the frontend team owns the website and app

what information is in the system
